statements.text: East Texas A&M University announced the hiring of Ashley Gordon as head coach of the Lions’ soccer program in January 2022.
Gordon is entering her fifth season as the Lion soccer skipper in 2026, being the program's coach for its entire time in NCAA Division I and the Southland Conference.
